summary: Retest of confirmation-amount bug. FIX VERIFIED. With payin response intentionally missing 'amount' and status returning amount=100, confirmation now shows 'paiement de 100 F' (not '0 F'). data-testid 'order-confirmed-title' resolves to 'Votre commande est confirmée 🎉'. Toast 'Paiement confirmé — Commande ord_mockr1' also displayed. Route intercepts on /api/paxity/payin and /api/paxity/status/tx_mockr1 both fired as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: Checkout.jsx L67-70 merge with prev state is correct and defensively covers the case where payin omits amount — good fix.
seed_data_creation: localStorage sec_cart_v1 seeded with single Casque item (price 100)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Only the amount-display bug was in scope for iteration_11 and is now fixed. Full checkout happy-path via mocked Paxity payin/status works end-to-end.
rca of the issue: Previously the poll handler only set setTransaction with the status response snapshot in a way that lost previously-set fields when cart.clear() reset context; the new merge setTransaction((prev) => ({...prev, ...res})) preserves amount/order_id regardless of whether payin response included amount.
